topic: Hyderabad's air hit AQI *509* on Diwali
hook: Hyderabad's air hit AQI *509* on Diwali night, then eased by Monday midday
hook_b: Hyderabad's AQI averaged *509* the night after Deepavali
tldr: Diwali night air went hazardous (Begumpet hit 828); Monday daytime reports are better.

beats.what: Siasat: at about 9:30 pm on Nov 8 the city's average AQI touched 509, and Begumpet reached 828. The Hindu reports PM2.5 at 392 µg/m³ and an overnight average of 509.
beats.why: Siasat: it took just two hours for the air to go from unhealthy to hazardous. Hyderabad Mail reports IMD expects dry conditions from Nov 9.
beats.care: Diwali night was the worst window. Monday daytime reports say moderate; still check your area's AQI before long outdoor runs.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Monday midday: Moneycontrol's post-Diwali AQI check ranked Hyderabad cleanest among the metros it listed. Daily Pioneer: 'moderate' air after Deepavali. Siasat published an explainer on what AQI readings mean.

cards.q: Did the smoke affect you last night?

qs: Diwali 2024's citywide AQI was 171. Is 509 a one-night spike or a new baseline for festival nights?
Why did Begumpet read 828 while the city average was 509?

facts.t: was Begumpet's AQI on Diwali night, Siasat reports.
was Hyderabad's citywide AQI on *Diwali 2024*, against an acceptable limit of 60. New Malakpet hit 335.
PM2.5 peaked at *475* at the US Consulate monitor on Diwali 2024.

viz.l: citywide AQI at ~9:30 pm, Diwali night
viz.verdict: Hazardous that night; eased by Monday midday

steps.e: Reports say moderate / cleanest of metros checked

viz.verdict: Air improved after the night peak

watch: Tonight's readings, in case smoke settles again, and IMD's dry-week forecast.

twist: By Monday midday, Moneycontrol ranked Hyderabad the cleanest of the post-Diwali metros it checked, and Daily Pioneer called the air 'moderate'.
